text: Across d_model = 64, 128 and 256 for seed 22 (m2 fixed, data_seed 0, 6000 steps), does the N=128 trained force R2 deficit shrink roughly geometrically with width (about 25% per doubling), so that extrapolation predicts closure below 0.04 at a reachable width? Or does it level off near 0.10 after the first doubling?
